bibl.title: Port town and its harbours: sedimentary proxies for landscape and seascape reconstruction of the Greco-Roman site of Berenike on the Red Sea coast of Egypt.
bibl.seg: Anna M. Kotarba-Morley, Port town and its harbours: sedimentary proxies for landscape and seascape reconstruction of the Greco-Roman site of Berenike on the Red Sea coast of Egypt.
Iwona Zych (ed.), Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/2. Research on the Red Sea (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 61-92, figg.
bibl.note: The site and its history. - Ancient sources and port locations. - Excavations in the harbour area. - Landscape and geomorphological setting. - Aims of the research. - Methods. - Results: Landscape reconstruction [by period]; - Interpretation. - Discussion 1: Scenarios to reconstruct the port city of Berenike. - Discussion 2: Estimating the capacity of Berenike's harbour. - Discussion 3: The port and its functionality. - Conclusions.
